prompt: Build me a personal portfolio website. I'm a frontend developer. I want something dark, futuristic, with a 3D animated background — maybe floating particles or a rotating geometric shape. Include sections for hero, about, skills, projects (show 3 placeholder projects), and contact. Keep it to a single HTML file with vanilla JS so I can just open it in a browser.

assertions.text: Delivers a single self-contained index.html file (no build step required)
Includes Three.js or CSS 3D animation in the hero section
Has at least 4 distinct sections: hero, about, skills/projects, contact
Uses a dark color scheme throughout
Implements scroll animations or transitions between sections
Layout is responsive (uses media queries or fluid units)
No placeholder TODOs or lorem ipsum text remain
